|game_text=Power +1 on Tatooine. Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate [[Arica]] to [[Luke (V){{!}}Luke]]'s location. During your control phase, if present at a battleground (and Luke is not), may retrieve 1 Force. Immune to [[Undercover (V){{!}}Undercover]] and attrition < 4.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Arica (V) (Virtual Block 4)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB4-01-Arica-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Virtual Block 4 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Arica (V) (Virtual Block 4)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Arica (V) (Virtual Block 4)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Power +1 on Tatooine. Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate Arica to Luke’s location. During your control phase, if present at a battleground (and Luke is not), may retrieve 1 Force. Immue to Undercover and attrition < 4.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the release-sheet wording again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Arica (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) corrected “Immue” to “Immune”. PC-E1 text: “Power +1 on Tatooine. Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate Arica to Luke's location. During your control phase, if present at a battleground (and Luke is not), may retrieve 1 Force. Immune to Undercover and attrition < 4.”<ref name="cl-1240_1">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
